title: India-Nepal's Shared Future Is "QR Code That Works On Both Sides": FonePay CEO Diwas Kumar At NDTV Anviksha
summary_full: Diwas Kumar called the India-Nepal corridor among the most active in the region, but said that its next generation “cannot run on the infrastructure of the previous one.”
